issues.issue: [fixed per checker: now charges for services/fees] The report prints what this line is made of (p10, p12, p14), and most of it is charges for services: camping fees 16,208, community center rentals 12,094, supply sales and service 2,156, messages 25 (30,483 of 36,529). The rest is franchise fees 1,621, permits 446, street interest 913 and misc 3,066. The rule for mixed lines is the dominant category ('charges for services/fees') plus a review note naming the mix, not 'other'.

Repayments of economic development loans. The Statement of Activities (p2) counts them as Community Development charges for services. They could also be seen as other financing (return of loan principal). 'other' is used, with a review note. Same for detail[36].

The report does not say where the grant came from. Village grants usually come from a government (state or federal), and 'donations/contributions' is meant for non-government sources. Same for detail[12].
